llm_response.reason: The site exhibits several key scam characteristics: a recently registered domain with short-term certificates, a lack of company or contact details (no about us/contact/info pages or real business address/phone/email), ambiguous references to privacy, generic claims of 100% safety and always free delivery, and no links to verifiable information. The minimal site structure and lack of transparency are commonly found in fake online shops set up for scams.
